extension.summary: Movies and TV shows from user-configured M3U feeds
extension.description: Appi caches configurable movie and TV M3U catalogues, provides fast indexed browsing, unified search and recently played/resume lists, and adds lightweight on-demand metadata through TMDb Helper.
extension.news: 0.7.0 - Add bounded background metadata for plots, posters, cast, episode names and genuine IMDb ratings through TMDb Helper, while preserving fast cached catalogue browsing.
